title: Liverpool receive boost in Milos Kerkez pursuit with Bournemouth set to announce his replacement
content:
Liverpool have received a significant boost in their pursuit of Bournemouth star Milos Kerkez.

The Cherries are reportedly set to complete a transfer for Rennes star Adrien Truffert, which will pave the way for Kerkez’s move to Anfield.

According to journalist Benjamin Quarez, Truffert has completed a medical and is poised to sign a five-year contract at the Vitality Stadium.

Liverpool have been chasing a move for Kerkez this summer. The 21-year-old joined Bournemouth in 2023 and has adapted seamlessly to life in England.

He has made 74 appearances across all competitions, with two goals and eight assists to his name.

The Hungary international played a pivotal role in helping his side secure a ninth-place Premier League finish last season, averaging 1.4 tackles, 1.2 interceptions, 4.4 ball recoveries and 2.6 clearances per game.

Kerkez has three years left on his contract, but Bournemouth are ready to sell him for £45 million.

Agreement on personal terms is not expected to be difficult, as the defender is keen to join Liverpool.

However, Kerkez’s move has triggered speculation surrounding Andy Robertson’s future at Anfield.

The Scotland international has been their first-choice left-back, but may no longer be an undisputed starter for next season.

Robertson’s situation has alerted Atletico Madrid, who have identified him as their top target at left-back this summer.
